en: Yes, is there something you need?

jp: すぐに、\nお取り替えします
でも、今日くらいは\n保ちそうよ
en: But it looks like it'll last for today, at least.

jp: 夜までに、交換して\nおけばいいわ
en: As long as you change it by tonight, that's fine.

jp: それより、手伝って\nほしいことがあるのよ
en: More importantly, there's something I'd like your help with.

jp: 手が空いたら、\n私の部屋にお願いね
en: When you have a free moment, come to my room, please.

jp: 電球、最初に見た\n時間じゃ、やっぱり\n切れてたよね？
en: The bulb... in the time we first saw, it was burnt out after all, wasn't it?

jp: りんりんがユリユリを\n見つけた時は\n電球は切れてた
en: When Rin-Rin found Yuri-Yuri, bulb was burnt out.

jp: あれ？　ここの電球\n切れてたよね？
en: Huh? The bulb here was burnt out, wasn't it?

jp: そうだね、\n麟がここで、ユリ子の\n遺体を発見した時は
en: That's right. When Rin found Yuriko's body here,
the bulb was burnt out as well.

jp: 【佳子とユリ子の会話】\nの刻音を手に入れた！
en: Obtained the [Yoshiko and Yuriko's Conversation] Echo!
